materials.name: Wood Materials
materials.notes: Sooty orange flame with red-orange ember glow at the base, hardwood burns steadier than softwood, organic material - use water or CO2

materials.name: Paper Products(Wood material)
materials.notes: Bright yellow to yellow-orange flame, burns quickly with little smoke, carbon-based combustion - use CO2 or water

materials.name: Natural Fibers
materials.notes: Smaller, less sooty pale orange-yellow flame, cotton burns fast, wool self-extinguishes, natural fiber - use water or CO2

materials.name: Plastic Materials
materials.notes: Yellow-orange flame dimmed by dense black smoke, melts and drips, synthetic material - use CO2

materials.name: Rubber Materials
materials.notes: Dark smoky red-orange flame with heavy black smoke, natural rubber has sulfur odor, synthetic varies, use CO2 or foam

materials.name: Foam Materials
materials.notes: Bright red-orange flame with heavy black smoke, rapid spread, synthetic foam - use CO2

materials.name: Wax Materials
materials.notes: Steady, very luminous yellow flame with near-white core and blue base, natural wax burns cleaner than synthetic, organic wax - use CO2 or water

materials.name: Alcohol-Based Products
materials.notes: Pale blue flame, nearly invisible in daylight, higher alcohol content = paler flame, use CO2 or water spray

materials.name: Liquid Fuels
materials.notes: Light fuels/vapours = deep blue flame, pool fires = vivid saturated orange with dark smoke, petroleum-based - use foam or CO2, never water

materials.name: Chemical Products
materials.notes: Solvents typically blue, metal-salt compounds give green or violet flames, check product label for specific guidance
